name: Each thing once, in the place of what it is
says: a message is in Messages, an event on the Calendar, a to-do or journal entry in Notes, each once and headed by its own words, and an invitation a message carries is on the Calendar as its event

measures.says: messages among the validation oracles' message examples (test/oracle/corpus.json) held more than once although they share one Message-ID
oracle messages, events, to-dos and journal entries listed in a place other than the one of what they are
oracle items that say something but are listed with no heading
oracle messages carrying an RFC 6047 invitation whose event is not on the calendar
